overview: A comprehensive educational website covering everything about whey protein in the fitness industry — what it is, types, safety, daily dosage, pricing, and a protein calculator to help users personalize their intake.
features: Hero section with clear overview and navigation
Whey protein types comparison (concentrate, isolate, hydrolysate)
Safety & side effects section with medical disclaimers
Daily dosage guide with personalized protein calculator
Pricing comparison by type with cost-per-serving breakdown
Fully responsive layout for mobile, tablet, and desktop
